title: Every semanticops domain is an entry point; srs-rust needs its own home (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
take a look at https://srs.semanticops.com

Does an agent arriving for the first time know how to use this quickly?
I think its missing info on srs-rust

Then .... srs-rust probably needs its own domain and home

---

engine is good.

we don't need to recod everyhing I say! Just the important elements that give work context.

Lets establish a standard way to build the semanticops subdomains, and then make sure that we provide a way for agents to adopt srs simply.

A new agent should be able to start from any semanticops domain, and know how to quickly get up and running.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-29; recorded verbatim (two messages). The owner chose engine.semanticops.com as srs-rust's home, macOS and linux-arm64 release builds, and hand-written engine pages first.
